Name: Pokemania
Author: TheKrominator
Description:
[center]The last major update to Stardew Valley has caused some issues with Pokemania. The mod is still available but I have not had time to maintain it. 

Check out this new companion mod for Pokemania! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15325]Pokemon Wonder Mail[/url][/center]
[left]﻿[/left][img]https://i.imgur.com/SzZNmH2.png[/img]

Required Mods : 
Content Patcher - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]
Content Patcher Animations - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853[/url]

Install :
1. Download this mod.
2. Unpack the mod into your "StardewValley\Mods" folder. If you don't have a "Mods" folder, just make one!
3. Run the game!

Other Mods that work great with Pokemania :
Visible Fish - see catchable fish in the water [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897[/url]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Are you still reading all of this? Hey! Welcome to my dev part of the write-up.
Stardew Valley and Pokémon are very dense worlds. I will always be working to improve this mods further, but there will certainly be features that I have missed. I welcome you to point them out so that I can fix them asap.

[b]Planned Features :[/b]
config settings - Having a config menu can help a lot when setting this mod with other mods. 
more critters - As Stardew Valley has expanded, so to has the wildlife. I plan to add more Pokémon to the list of flying and other creatures that you may catch dashing through the bushes.
more Pokémon - Of course, I will keep adding to the list when I find the inspiration for certain items in the game. 
[s]Pokésounds - Include music from the Pokémon world and replace many of the animals sounds with Pokémon cries.[/s]
